_about: One plain line for each shared-framework file, reworded by hand on Oct 31 from deliverables/2026-10-31/census-notes.json. The original note stays in files.json and on each file's sheet.

abmil.pyproject.toml: Tells the installer to include the ABMIL files.
abmil.wsip/core/jobs.py: Job setup now looks a method up in a table, not just CLAM.
abmil.wsip/methods/base.py: Adds a setting for random numbers during validation.
abmil.wsip/methods/registry.py: Adds ABMIL to the shared method list, rewrites its lookup.
abmil.wsip/orchestration/config.py: Adds ABMIL's settings here, repeating existing task checks.
abmil.wsip/training/session.py: Training loop: can protect random numbers in validation.
abmil.wsip/worker/run.py: The worker now picks a method by name, not always CLAM.

transmil.docs/shared-engine.md: Updates the shared docs for a new optional training mode.
transmil.pyproject.toml: Tells the installer to include the TransMIL files.
transmil.tests/training/conftest.py: Lets the shared test setup use methods other than CLAM.
transmil.tests/training/test_accumulation.py: New shared tests for the optional training mode.
transmil.wsip/core/jobs.py: Job setup now looks a method up in a table, not just CLAM.
transmil.wsip/methods/registry.py: Adds TransMIL to the shared method list, rewrites its lookup.
transmil.wsip/orchestration/config.py: Moves CLAM's task checks, then adds TransMIL's settings.
transmil.wsip/orchestration/control.py: Can now refuse a slide list that has no patient IDs.
transmil.wsip/training/policies.py: Adds options for when training stops, to match TransMIL.
transmil.wsip/training/session.py: Training loop: adds a mode that updates every few slides.
transmil.wsip/worker/run.py: The worker picks a method by name, can check patient IDs.

dtfd-mil.CHANGELOG.md: Adds a changelog entry for this draft method.
dtfd-mil.docs/shared-engine.md: Adds a docs section on the new optional training steps.
dtfd-mil.pyproject.toml: Tells the installer to include the DTFD-MIL files.
dtfd-mil.tests/contract/test_adapter_contract.py: Widens the test every method must pass, for two-tier training.
dtfd-mil.tests/contract/test_contract_catches_bug: Adds checks that the shared test really fails on known bugs.
dtfd-mil.tests/training/conftest.py: Lets the shared test setup use methods other than CLAM.
dtfd-mil.tests/training/lifecycle_toy.py: New test helper: a small two-tier example.
dtfd-mil.tests/training/test_epoch_schedule.py: New shared tests: learning-rate schedules and resuming.
dtfd-mil.tests/training/test_final_validation.py: New shared tests: final predictions match the chosen round.
dtfd-mil.tests/training/test_gradient_clipping.py: New shared tests: limits on gradient size, per group.
dtfd-mil.tests/training/test_lifecycle_defaults.p: New shared tests: defaults keep the existing training steps.
dtfd-mil.tests/training/test_metric_selection.py: New shared tests: choosing the best round by a metric.
dtfd-mil.tests/training/test_named_optimizers.py: New shared tests: several optimizers survive a resume.
dtfd-mil.tests/training/test_python_shuffle.py: New shared tests: a second way to shuffle slides.
dtfd-mil.tests/training/test_update_phases.py: New shared tests: training steps run in the declared order.
dtfd-mil.tests/training/test_zero_grad_timing.py: New shared tests: when gradients are reset.
dtfd-mil.wsip/core/jobs.py: Job setup now looks a method up in a table, not just CLAM.
dtfd-mil.wsip/data/manifest.py: Adds an optional check that every slide has a patient ID.
dtfd-mil.wsip/methods/base.py: Adds options for every method: two tiers, clipping, schedules.
dtfd-mil.wsip/methods/registry.py: Adds DTFD-MIL to the shared method list, rewrites its lookup.
dtfd-mil.wsip/orchestration/config.py: Moves CLAM's task checks, then adds DTFD-MIL's settings.
dtfd-mil.wsip/orchestration/control.py: Checks patient IDs when a method requires them.
dtfd-mil.wsip/tasks/classification.py: Lists which metrics may choose the best training round.
dtfd-mil.wsip/training/policies.py: Adds a rule: pick the best round by a named metric.
dtfd-mil.wsip/training/session.py: Training loop: fixed steps replaced with configurable ones.
dtfd-mil.wsip/worker/run.py: Final predictions now come from training, or it refuses.
